basic_info.description: Resting on a flat tree-lined block in the heart of Pacific Heights is this spacious corner unit that boasts two bedrooms, two baths, and approx. 1,620 sqft. The condo is flooded with natural light and includes beautiful hardwood floors, arched doorways, period moldings, and classic double-hung windows. The living room is wrapped in windows and features a wood-burning fireplace, built-in cabinetry, and impressive views of the neighborhood and portions of downtown. The adjacent dining room provides ample space for hosting dinner parties. The kitchen has been renovated with contemporary finishes and includes a gas range, quartz counters, and ample cabinetry. Just outside of the kitchen is a flexible space that is an ideal place for a home office. The two restful bedrooms are positioned on opposite sides of the unit and both include access to en-suite bathrooms and walk-in closets. The bathrooms proudly feature vintage tile, archways over the showers/tubs, and marble-top vanities. 2090 Pacific Ave is a classic 1920's elevator building that includes one car parking (can accommodate an SUV), additional storage, and laundry. Ideally located in Pacific Heights within close proximity to Lafayette Park and the restaurants/shops along both Union St and Fillmore St.
